notes.title: True Colours Release Date Confirmed - October 4th 2023!
notes.notes:
Hey hey, gamers!

Borealis here, and I'm absolutely thrilled to announce that True Colours will release right here on Steam on October 4th!

I'm SO pumped for you all to finally discover the truth behind this crazy story I've written!  I can promise you that there are plot twists and shocks you won't see coming, and I can't wait to see your reactions!  Are you ready for hot dates, terrifying betrayals and attempted redemption arcs?

In the run up to release, the game will be featuring on several livestreams, let's plays and press reviews - I'll share those details as and when I can.  In the meantime, you know what you gotta do - get this twisted tale on your wishlist and spread the word!  There's a new dating sim in town, and it is NOT for the faint hearted~

See ya soon!
Borealis
